fact: Al Chourouk reports that Tunisia's Ministry of Health has begun the first pilot of a digital birth-declaration system, described as a civil registration and vital statistics digitisation step.

UNFPA Tunisie reports that three workshops (20 Nov, 4 Dec, 11 Dec 2025) involving 72 municipalities gave civil registrars intensive training on the digital system Medania for accurate and fast declarations in the civil-registration and vital-statistics system.

The Tunisian cabinet council of 15 August 2026 listed among 114 projects under way the electronic exchange of civil-status annotations (mentions d'etat civil) between consulates abroad and municipalities, with several projects past 90% progress.
system: echange electronique des mentions d'etat civil entre les consulats a l'etranger et les municipalites
